all.text: At this latitude, the Earth's spin carries the ship east at about 880 mph, whatever the captain is doing.
The sun reaches its highest point here about 61 minutes after it does in Southampton.
Drill straight through the Earth from here and you'd surface at 31.9°S, 163.3°E, about 1,150 km from Sydney.
This far north, they're roughly level with Shanghai, even though it's a world away.
